utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Ira?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s going pretty well so far—people have been dropping off a few useful things while I’ve been out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s good to hear. Do you want me to help sort anything when you’re back?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might need a hammer and some screwdrivers. I’ve been a bit out of it lately, so a reminder on the time would help too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I can bring a hammer and a set of screwdrivers. The repair drive starts at 10 a.m., and I’ll remind you again before then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout already—people are dropping off tools and checking the donation list. If you need anything specific, I can ask around for you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear. I’m just worried we’ll run out of boxes and labels before the afternoon, so if you can ask around for those too, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll ask around for boxes and labels too. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you take the donated tools over to the community center on Maple Street and keep them by the front desk?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll take the donated tools over to the community center on Maple Street and leave them by the front desk.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive — want me to put you down to help out or just keep you posted?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just keep me posted for now, Quinn. I’m not up for taking anything on yet, but I appreciate you asking.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted and won’t put you on anything yet. Thanks for letting me know, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m putting together the repair drive list now, and I’d love your help with it. What do you think we should prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the most urgent safety fixes first, then anything that keeps people from using their homes normally.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes perfect sense — I’ll put urgent safety fixes at the top, then move to anything blocking daily use. If you think of any specific homes or issues, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what needs repairing and where the drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure on the full list yet, but I can check and let you know. I think the drive is happening over by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Please check the full repair list when you can, and let me know the exact spot by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive. What timing are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Faye. Let’s aim for after school pickup and before dinner, so folks can swing by without rushing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I’ll plan around the after-pickup window and spread the word. If you want, I can also help line up a couple of volunteers for that time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces, so I might have this wrong — is the repair drive still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s still on for this weekend — we’re meeting Saturday morning. If you want, I can send you the time and what folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please — send me the time and a quick list of what people are bringing, so I can stay in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still able to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll stop by and see what still needs fixing. If you’ve got a list, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, Rey. I’ve got a few things in mind, though I may need a minute to remember them all.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No rush — I can wait while you think it through.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll let the neighbors know the plan. Just tell me what you need me to repeat.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — please tell everyone we’re collecting tools, batteries, and spare extension cords, and to drop them by my place this evening.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell the neighbors we’re collecting tools, batteries, and spare extension cords, and to drop them by your place this evening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’ll ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you checking around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll stop by a couple places and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a quick reminder of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need to sort the donated tools and set up the repair tables, then we can welcome folks as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll sort the donated tools and help set up the repair tables. Then I’ll be ready to welcome folks as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I’m sorry, I missed the details—what’s changing, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s just a quick neighborhood repair drive—drop off any broken small appliances, tools, or bikes and we’ll sort what can be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it—so just broken small stuff like appliances, tools, and bikes. I can probably bring over a couple things this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a few tools if you need them for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a quick list and bring it by, so we can keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — bring it by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing—could you help spread the word and maybe bring a few tools or extra hands if you know anyone? I’m letting everyone know it’ll be this Saturday afternoon at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and see who can come by with tools or lend a hand. Saturday afternoon at the community shed, got it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad you brought up the repair drive, Opal — I can help connect folks and see who’s able to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Jules — I can keep track of who’s helping and where each item needs to go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll start reaching out and line up a few helpers, then we can match people to the right items.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m pulling the repair drive details together now, and I’d love your help if you can lend a hand. I’ll keep it organized and send you the next steps shortly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help keep track of the supplies. Send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll note what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’m sending the list now, and I’ll flag the gaps so we can fill them in quickly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s still going on—what do you need to know about it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you still need volunteers or just supplies?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think both are still useful, but I only heard that second-hand—do you want me to check which they need more?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — can you help sort the donations and keep an eye on pickup times? I’m juggling school drop-off, so that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can sort the donations and watch the pickup times. Just send me the details and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time the repair drive starts, and what you want me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure of the start time yet, but I’ll check and let you know. If you can, bring a few basic tools and some gloves.
